sanskrit_verse: स्थावरेषु विवादेषु भुक्तिस्त्रिपुरुषी च या / स्वतन्त्रैव हि सा ज्ञेया प्रमाणं साध्यनिर्णये //
transliteration: sthāvareṣu vivādeṣu bhuktis tripuruṣī ca yā / svatantraiva hi sā jñeyā pramāṇaṃ sādhyaniṛṇaye //
sph_interpretive_translation: In disputes concerning immovable property, the right of enjoyment extending over three generations shall be deemed self-authoritative and constitutes valid evidence for determining ownership.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from continuity of conscious enjoyment, not mere claim
Causation is established through unbroken experiential possession across time
Capacity-based responsibility arises from sustained stewardship
Restoration logic prioritizes lived harmony over abstract title
Consciousness alignment occurs when factual use supersedes theoretical assertion
executable_legal_axioms: IF property dispute EXISTS AND usage spans THREE generations THEN evidentiary weight ASSIGNED to possessor
IF claimant LACKS three-generation continuity THEN claim SUBORDINATED to experiential tenure
IF conflict arises IN sthāvara domain THEN adjudication PRIORITIZES lived administration OVER documentary assertion
IF possession demonstrates conscious integration THEN legal recognition AUTOMATICALLY granted
supreme_court_application: Supreme judicial authority shall recognize tri-generational experiential tenure as prima facie evidence in immovable property disputes, overriding speculative claims lacking such demonstrable continuity. The threshold of responsibility lies in the capacity to sustain conscious alignment with the land’s inherent order.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through anupūrvaśaḥ—sequential manifestation of integrated living. The non-punitive alignment arises naturally as misaligned claims dissolve upon encountering the factual continuum of consciousness-rooted stewardship.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Facilitate acknowledgment of actual possession timelines
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Encourage claimants to align with factual stewardship
Capacity Restoration: Support integration between disputing parties and the land’s natural order
Integrity Reintegration: Establish harmony through recognition of lived dharmic relationship
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma is restored. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
